title: 1.11 With him, with her, with them
unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people’s habits.
lesson_title: With him, with her, with them
sub_lesson_title: With him, with her, with them
goal: Say who people do things with, using him, her and them instead of the person (She cooks dinner with her husband. / She cooks dinner with him.), and answer Who does ... with?
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 1.11 Friends and People: A1 names a husband and wife, their son and daughter and a friend (The husband and the wife are talking.); A1+ 1.11 says who they do things with. The one new grammar relationship is the object pronoun after with: him, her and them replace the person (She cooks dinner with her husband. / She cooks dinner with him.), next to the subject pronouns he, she and they. Her is both the possessive (her friend) and the object (with her).
prerequisite: A1 1.11 husband, wife, son, daughter, friend; A1 1.4 children; A1 1.6 mother, father; A1 3.10 his and her; A1 7.6 play football; A1+ 1.2 reads and the he/she -s (cooks, plays); A1+ 1.4 with; A1+ 1.9 Who does ... with?
speaking_outcome: Say him, her and them clearly at the end of the sentence, linked to with (with him, with her, with them); the th of them is soft. Do not require native-like speed.
